title: What's New in Murmur {{version}}
dontShowHint: You can turn it back on in Settings › General.

0.9.0.title: Send audio to Murmur from other apps
0.9.0.text: Murmur is in the Share menu: pick an audio file in Finder, Messages or any app that shares files, and Murmur transcribes it. You can also use Finder › Open With or drop it on the Dock icon.

0.8.0.title: Transcribe from a file
0.8.0.text: With File › Transcribe from File… (⌘O) you can open an mp3, m4a, wav, ogg or any other audio file, and Murmur turns it into a meeting with speakers and the final pass. It works out the language by itself.

0.8.0.title: Murmur, from Claude too
0.8.0.text: Claude Desktop and Claude Code can read and search your meetings and transcribe audio on this Mac with Murmur. Audio never leaves the Mac.

0.8.0.title: A new mark
0.8.0.text: The two bars looked like a pause button. Now Murmur is an “m” and its echo: the voice and the transcript.

0.8.0.title: Clearer settings
0.8.0.text: There's a button to close them, and they say “Saved” each time you change something.

0.7.1.title: Bigger or smaller notes text
0.7.1.text: Use ⌘+ and ⌘− to change the size of the notes text, and ⌘0 to go back to normal. It's also in the View menu.

0.7.0.title: Every meeting as Markdown in your folder
0.7.0.text: Choose a folder and Murmur saves the summary, notes and transcript there when each meeting ends. While recording, you can turn it on or off from the top bar.

0.7.0.title: The cover is now called Summary
0.7.0.text: That's its name across the app and on shared pages. Exporting or copying as Markdown now includes the summary too.

0.7.0.title: A stop button that's easier to see
0.7.0.text: The button that stops the recording, in the top bar, is bigger and easier to spot.

0.6.0.title: Set up Cloudflare from Murmur
0.6.0.text: Open Cloudflare with the token ready, paste it, and Murmur publishes your sharing space there. No terminal needed.

0.6.0.title: Share screenshots and audio too
0.6.0.text: Choose what's included. Whoever opens the link can listen to the recording, jump to any minute and download it all as Markdown. Shared meetings show a link icon.

0.6.0.title: Transcribe again in another language
0.6.0.text: If you recorded in the wrong language, Whisper listens to it again in Catalan, Spanish or English, from the meeting's title menu.

0.5.0.title: Share a meeting with a link
0.5.0.text: Choose whether to share the cover, the notes or the transcript, when the link expires and whether it has a password. Murmur encrypts it on this Mac and publishes it on your Cloudflare account, which is free.

0.5.0.title: More reliable updates
0.5.0.text: The update package unpacks properly, and if something goes wrong, the window explains it without getting distorted.

0.4.0.title: Tags to organise your meetings
0.4.0.text: Add as many as you like under a meeting's title. You can filter by them in the sidebar and search for them. Right-click to rename, merge or delete them.

0.4.0.title: Choose before you start
0.4.0.text: When you start recording you can pick the language and say whether more people are in the room. If someone joins halfway through, you can change it without stopping the recording.

0.4.0.title: Covers by Claude or OpenAI too
0.4.0.text: With your own account and key, the cover is written in seconds and you can pick the model. Only the text is sent, never the audio. By default everything still happens on this Mac.

0.4.0.title: A handier recording bar
0.4.0.text: The screenshot is now the main button, and stopping a recording asks you to confirm. You can also export a meeting's screenshots.

0.4.0.title: One job at a time
0.4.0.text: While you're recording another meeting or on a call, Murmur waits before finishing the previous one, so your Mac doesn't slow down. Each speaker in a call also gets their own colour.

0.3.0.title: Meetings in Catalan, Spanish or English
0.3.0.text: Choose the language people speak. With “Catalan + Spanish” it understands both, even mixed in the same sentence.

0.3.0.title: Whisper goes over the transcript
0.3.0.text: If the meeting is in a single language, Whisper listens to it again when it ends and adds punctuation, capitals and properly spelled names. About 6 minutes per hour of meeting.

0.3.0.title: Murmur, now in Spanish and English too
0.3.0.text: The interface follows your system language. You can change it whenever you like.

0.3.0.title: The cover, in the language you choose
